title: 第25章 赎回手镯第26章 担心的常婉茹
lines: 黑衣人死亡。
江尘擦了擦脸上沾染的血迹，心中松了一口气。
此次事件实在危险，还好这黑衣人只是刚刚开辟气海的初级武师，武技熟练度也不高。
否则江尘怕是难逃此劫。
“让我来看看，你到底是谁。”
江尘走到尸体前，揭下面罩，一张普普通通的中年人面孔出现在眼前。
“果然如此，还真是你们啊！”
江尘眼中涌现出浓浓的杀意。
如果说刚刚他还有些怀疑，现在就完全确定了。
这个中年人他一周前还在家族大比中见过，名为江大荣，正是亲近大房的旁系之一！
自己才刚来苍庐森林第二天，就有一名杀手找上门来。
这说明江旭父子二人很可能从自己离开玄武城不久之后便派出了人手。
经此一事，两家之间便再无回转的余地，不是你死，就是我亡！
“这样说来，我今晚回去的时候就要小心了。”
“万一被江旭父子二人发现了江大荣任务失败，很可能会派出更强的武师。”
修炼者到了武师阶段，气海每扩大一分，实力便会成倍提升。
到了武师巅峰，即便是最普通的武师，也至少能发挥出二十象之力。
而这还仅仅只是力量方面的优势。
可想而知，这样的强敌绝不是江尘能够对付的。
所以，在拥有更强的实力之前，江尘必须要尽可能的隐藏自己。
一念作罢，江尘召唤出武魂，开始炼化江大荣体内的灵气。
等江大荣的灵气全部炼化完毕之后，反馈到体内的灵气浓度比武徒高得多。
江尘连忙就近找了一个安静的地方坐下来，将上午积累的所有妖丹全部吞噬之后，便再次开始修炼。
这一次，在大量灵气的加持下，江尘一连冲破了三条经脉，才终于停了下来。
一共二十四条经脉，加上肉身强度，令江尘的力量终于达到三象之力。
如今的力量，已经可以与初入中阶的妖兽一战。
不过为了防止意外，暂时还不能与中阶妖兽直面接触。
否则，万一迎面碰上一头实力超标的中阶妖兽，可就要当场翻车了。
“继续狩猎吧，现在的实力，实在没什么安全感。”
傍晚。
江尘带着一包袱狩猎过程中采摘的低级灵药，经过一番简单的乔装打扮之后，趁天黑之前回到了玄武城。
在将这些低级灵药全部出售以后，江尘拿着换来的二百三十两银票，来到钱家当铺。
当铺中坐着一个值班的老鉴定师。
content_en:
The man in black dies.
Jiang Chen wiped the blood on his face and breathed a sigh of relief.
This incident is really dangerous. Fortunately, the man in black is just a junior martial artist who has just opened up the Qi Sea, and his martial arts proficiency is not high.
Otherwise, Jiang Chen might not be able to escape this disaster.
"Let me see who you really are."
Jiang Chen walked to the body and took off his mask, revealing an ordinary middle-aged face.
"As expected, it's really you!"
Jiang Chen's eyes showed strong murderous intent.
If he had some doubts just now, he was completely sure now.
He had met this middle-aged man in the family competition a week ago. His name was Jiang Darong, and he was one of the side clan members who was close to Dafang!
On the second day after he arrived in Canglu Forest, a killer came to his door.
This shows that Jiang Xu and his son probably sent out men shortly after they left Xuanwu City.
After this incident, there is no room for turning back between the two families. Either you die or I die!
"In this case, I have to be careful when I go back tonight."
"If Jiang Xu and his son find out that Jiang Darong failed in his mission, they will probably send stronger martial arts masters."
When a practitioner reaches the martial arts stage, his strength will increase exponentially every time the Qi Sea expands.
At the peak of martial arts, even the most ordinary martial artist can exert at least the power of twenty images.
And this is just an advantage in terms of strength.
It is conceivable that Jiang Chen cannot deal with such a powerful enemy.
Therefore, Jiang Chen must hide himself as much as possible before he has stronger strength.
Giving up on the thought, Jiang Chen summoned his martial soul and began to refine the spiritual energy in Jiang Darong's body.
After Jiang Darong's spiritual energy was completely refined, the concentration of spiritual energy fed back into his body was much higher than that of a martial artist.
Jiang Chen quickly found a quiet place nearby to sit down, and after devouring all the demon pills accumulated in the morning, he started practicing again.
This time, with the blessing of a large amount of spiritual energy, Jiang Chen broke through three meridians in a row before finally stopping.
With a total of twenty-four meridians, coupled with the physical strength, Jiang Chen's power finally reached the power of the three images.
The current strength can already fight against the monster beasts who have just entered the intermediate level.
However, in order to prevent accidents, direct contact with mid-level monsters is not allowed for the time being.
Otherwise, if you encounter a mid-level monster with excessive strength, you will be overturned on the spot.
"Keep hunting. With our current strength, there is really no sense of security."
Evening.
Jiang Chen brought a bag of low-level elixirs picked during hunting, and after putting on a simple disguise, returned to Xuanwu City before dark.
After selling all these low-level elixirs, Jiang Chen took the two hundred and thirty taels of silver notes he got in exchange for them and went to the Qian family pawn shop.
There was an old appraiser on duty sitting in the pawn shop.
